messages:
Priya: Heads-up — last ~30m we've seen a spike of GPU pod evictions in ap-southeast-2c.
Jon: Same. apps hit sudden 5s node heartbeats -> kubelet marks NotReady -> taints applied -> preempt.
Eli: Any common denominator? same instance types? warm pools?
Priya: Mostly p4d-family racks, warm-node pools for training. Network errors around 10.10.3.x from the node NICs.
infra-alerts: [ALERT] conntrack_slab_high on ap-southeast-2c-rack-11 (90th%=78%): https://metrics/redwood/conntrack
Jon: Logs show `heartbeat_lat_ms` climbing 2000ms then kubelet de-prioritizes and we see `NodeReady==false`.
Priya: Snippet:
```
I0315 12:03:41.123 kubelet: NodeStatus update failed: timeout
I0315 12:03:43.128 kubelet: Marking node as NotReady, taints added: node.kubernetes.io/unreachable:NoExecute
``` 
Eli: That NotReady -> taint TTL triggers descheduler and preempt evictions even for long-running reserved jobs.
Priya: Hypothesis: NIC firmware combined with aggressive conntrack GC on rack switch causing transient packet loss -> heartbeat jitter.
Jon: Short term workaround: increase `--node-status-update-frequency` and `--eviction-hard` buffer on warm pools? also bump `taint-based-eviction` TTL from 300s to 600s for affected AZ.
Eli: Agreed. We can also add `--kubelet-eviction-pressure` tuning and add config to avoid evicting pods with `redwood.com/reserved=true` label.
Priya: I'll open a canary to apply a 2x taint TTL to warm-pool nodes in ap-southeast-2c; monitor preempts.
Jon: Also rolling NIC firmware on rack-11 tomorrow 0300UTC. Coordinating with network.
scheduler-bot: Suggested action: patch scheduler to ignore transient NotReady for pods with gpu=true and reserved=true for 5m. PR: https://git/repo/patch/123
Eli: Telemetry asks: add histogram for `taint_ttl_before_eviction` per-AZ, to verify regressions.
Priya: Plan: (1) apply taint-ttl canary; (2) schedule NIC firmware; (3) roll scheduler patch if canary stable 6h. Volunteers? Jon + Priya.
Jon: on it. I'll post status updates here. :thumbsup:
Priya: thanks — will alert customers with reserved capacity SLA if we need maintenance window.
infra-alerts: [INFO] Warm pool preemptions dropped from 12 -> 1 after config canary at 12:45 UTC.
Priya: Closing loop, will follow up in postmortem with timeline and graphs.
